questions.question_text: What does HTML stand for?
questions.option_a: Hyper Text Markup Language
questions.option_b: High Text Modern Language
questions.option_c: Hyper Transfer Markup Level
questions.option_d: Home Tool Markup Language
questions.explanation: HTML stands for HyperText Markup Language, the standard markup language for documents designed to be displayed in a web browser.

questions.question_text: Who is the inventor of the World Wide Web and HTML?
questions.option_a: Bill Gates
questions.option_b: Tim Berners-Lee
questions.option_c: Brendan Eich
questions.option_d: James Gosling
questions.explanation: Sir Tim Berners-Lee invented HTML and the World Wide Web in 1989-1990.

questions.question_text: Which HTML element is used to define the title of a document?
questions.option_a: <meta>
questions.option_b: <head>
questions.option_c: <title>
questions.option_d: <header>
questions.explanation: The <title> tag defines the title of the document shown in the browser toolbar or tab.

questions.question_text: Which is the largest heading tag in HTML?
questions.option_b: <head>
questions.option_c: <heading>
questions.explanation: <h1> defines the most important and largest default heading in standard HTML.

questions.question_text: What is the correct HTML element for inserting a line break?
questions.option_a: <lb>
questions.option_b: <break>
questions.option_d: <newline>
questions.explanation: produces a line break in text (carriage-return).

questions.question_text: What is the correct HTML for creating a hyperlink?
questions.option_a: Samyak
questions.option_b: Samyak
questions.option_c: <link url="https://samyak.in">Samyak</link>
questions.option_d: https://samyak.in
questions.explanation: The <a> tag with href attribute is used for hyperlinks.

questions.question_text: Which character is used to indicate an end tag in HTML?
questions.explanation:
A forward slash (/) is used before the tag name in closing tags, e.g.,

.

questions.question_text: How can you open a link in a new tab/browser window?
questions.option_a: <a href="url" target="_blank">
questions.option_b: <a href="url" new>
questions.option_c: <a href="url" target="new">
questions.option_d: <a href="url" window="_new">
questions.explanation: target="_blank" tells the browser to open the linked document in a new window or tab.

questions.question_text: Which element is used to specify a footer for a document or section?
questions.option_a: <bottom>
questions.option_b: <footer>
questions.option_c: <section-footer>
questions.option_d: <foot>
questions.explanation: The <footer> tag defines a footer for a document or section.

questions.question_text: What is the correct HTML for adding a background color?
questions.option_a: <body bg="yellow">
questions.option_b: <body style="background-color:yellow;">
questions.option_c: <background>yellow</background>
questions.option_d: <body color="yellow">
questions.explanation: Modern HTML uses CSS style="background-color: yellow;" or external stylesheets.

questions.question_text: Which HTML attribute specifies an alternate text for an image, if the image cannot be displayed?
questions.option_a: title
questions.option_b: src
questions.option_c: alt
questions.option_d: longdesc
questions.explanation: The alt attribute provides alternative text for accessibility and screen readers.

questions.question_text: Which HTML element is used to display a scalar measurement within a range?
questions.option_a: <range>
questions.option_b: <meter>
questions.option_c: <gauge>
questions.option_d: <measure>
questions.explanation: The <meter> element represents a scalar value within a known range or fractional value.

questions.question_text: What is the correct HTML for making a checkbox input?
questions.option_a: <input type="check">
questions.option_b: <checkbox>
questions.option_c: <input type="checkbox">
questions.option_d: <check>
questions.explanation: <input type="checkbox"> defines a checkbox control.

questions.question_text: What is the correct HTML for making a text input area with multiple lines?
questions.option_a: <input type="textbox">
questions.option_b: <textarea>
questions.option_c: <input type="text" multiline="true">
questions.option_d: <text-multiline>
questions.explanation: The <textarea> tag defines a multi-line text input control.

questions.question_text: Which HTML doctype declaration is correct for HTML5?
questions.option_a: <!DOCTYPE html>
questions.option_b: <!DOCTYPE HTML PUBLIC "-//W3C//DTD HTML 5.0//EN">
questions.option_c: <!DOCTYPE HTML5>
questions.option_d: <!DOCTYPE html-5>
questions.explanation: <!DOCTYPE html> is the concise, case-insensitive HTML5 doctype.

questions.question_text: Which HTML element is used to specify navigation links?
questions.option_a: <navigation>
questions.option_b: <nav>
questions.option_c: <navigate>
questions.option_d: <links>
questions.explanation: The <nav> element defines a set of navigation links.

questions.question_text: Which HTML tag is used for ordered (numbered) lists?
questions.option_a: <ul>
questions.option_b: <dl>
questions.option_c: <ol>
questions.option_d: <list>
questions.explanation: <ol> defines an ordered list, where items are marked with numbers by default.

questions.question_text: Which HTML element represents emphasized text that carries semantic importance?
questions.option_b: <bold>
questions.option_c: <em>
questions.option_d: <italic>
questions.explanation: <em> signifies stress emphasis on its contents, typically rendered in italics.

questions.question_text: Which input type defines a slider control in HTML5?
questions.option_a: <input type="slider">
questions.option_b: <input type="range">
questions.option_c: <input type="controls">
questions.option_d: <input type="bar">
questions.explanation: The <input type="range"> defines a slider control.

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of the <meta charset="UTF-8"> tag?
questions.option_a: Defines CSS version
questions.option_b: Specifies character encoding for the HTML document
questions.option_c: Defines screen resolution
questions.option_d: Specifies JavaScript engine
questions.explanation: UTF-8 covers almost all characters and symbols in the world, preventing encoding issues.

questions.question_text: Which HTML5 element is used for drawing graphics on the fly via JavaScript?
questions.option_a: <svg>
questions.option_b: <canvas>
questions.option_c: <draw>
questions.option_d: <graphic>
questions.explanation: The <canvas> element is used to draw graphics via scripting (usually JavaScript).

questions.question_text: Which HTML tag is used to embed audio files natively in HTML5?
questions.option_a: <sound>
questions.option_b: <audio>
questions.option_c: <mp3>
questions.option_d: <music>
questions.explanation: The <audio> element is used to embed sound content in documents.

questions.question_text: Which attribute in <video> allows automatic playback when loaded?
questions.option_a: autoplay
questions.option_b: play
questions.option_c: auto
questions.option_d: start="now"
questions.explanation: autoplay causes video to begin playing automatically as soon as it can.

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of semantic HTML elements?
questions.option_a: They make the file smaller
questions.option_b: They clearly describe their meaning to both the browser and developer
questions.option_c: They are required for PHP
questions.option_d: They disable CSS styles
questions.explanation: Semantic tags like <header>, <article>, and <footer> give clear meaning to structure.

questions.question_text: Which HTML element represents independent, self-contained content such as a blog post or news story?
questions.option_a: <section>
questions.option_b: <aside>
questions.option_c: <article>
questions.option_d: <div>
questions.explanation: The <article> tag specifies independent, self-contained content.

questions.question_text: Which tag defines content aside from the content it is placed in (like a sidebar)?
questions.option_a: <sidebar>
questions.option_b: <aside>
questions.option_c: <subcontent>
questions.option_d: <margin>
questions.explanation: <aside> defines content tangentially related to the content around it.

questions.question_text: Which HTML attribute specifies that an input field must be filled out before submitting?
questions.option_a: validate
questions.option_b: required
questions.option_c: necessary
questions.option_d: mandatory
questions.explanation: The required attribute specifies that an input field must not be empty.

questions.question_text: Which element is used to group related elements in a form with a visible border?
questions.option_a: <group>
questions.option_b: <fieldset>
questions.option_c: <block>
questions.option_d: <form-group>
questions.explanation: The <fieldset> tag is used to group related elements in a form.

questions.question_text: What is the caption element used specifically inside <fieldset>?
questions.option_a: <label>
questions.option_b: <legend>
questions.option_c: <caption>
questions.option_d: <title>
questions.explanation: <legend> defines a caption for the <fieldset> element.

questions.question_text: What is the default method for an HTML form when not specified?
questions.option_a: POST
questions.option_b: GET
questions.option_c: PUT
questions.option_d: FETCH
questions.explanation: The default HTTP method for form submission is GET.

questions.question_text: Which attribute specifies where to send the form-data when a form is submitted?
questions.option_a: target
questions.option_b: action
questions.option_c: method
questions.option_d: route
questions.explanation: The action attribute defines where form data is sent on submit.

questions.question_text: Which HTML tag is used to define table rows?
questions.option_a: <td>
questions.option_b: <th>
questions.option_c: <tr>
questions.option_d: <table-row>
questions.explanation: <tr> defines a row of cells in a table.

questions.question_text: Which HTML tag defines a table header cell?
questions.option_a: <td>
questions.option_b: <th>
questions.option_c: <head>
questions.option_d: <cell-head>
questions.explanation: <th> defines a header cell in an HTML table, rendered bold and centered by default.

questions.question_text: How do you create an HTML comment?
questions.option_a: // This is a comment
questions.option_b: /* This is a comment */
questions.option_c: <!-- This is a comment -->
questions.option_d: # This is a comment
questions.explanation: <!-- comment text --> is the comment syntax in HTML.

questions.question_text: Which HTML attribute provides a tooltip when hovering over an element?
questions.option_a: alt
questions.option_b: tooltip
questions.option_c: title
questions.option_d: hover
questions.explanation: The title attribute provides extra advisory information displayed as a tooltip.

questions.question_text: Which HTML element is used to highlight or mark text with a yellow background by default?
questions.option_a: <highlight>
questions.option_b: <mark>
questions.option_c: <yellow>
questions.option_d: <em>
questions.explanation: The <mark> element represents text that is marked or highlighted for reference.

questions.question_text: What is the correct tag for superscript text in HTML (e.g., x²)?
questions.option_a: <super>
questions.option_b: <sup>
questions.option_c: <sub>
questions.option_d: <up>
questions.explanation: <sup> defines superscript text, raised above the baseline.

questions.question_text: What is the correct tag for subscript text in HTML (e.g., H₂O)?
questions.option_a: <subscript>
questions.option_b: <down>
questions.option_c: <sub>
questions.option_d: <sup>
questions.explanation: <sub> defines subscript text, lowered below the baseline.

questions.question_text: Which tag defines preformatted text where whitespace and line breaks are preserved?
questions.option_a: <code>
questions.option_b: <pre>
questions.option_c: <format>
questions.option_d: <samp>
questions.explanation: The <pre> element represents preformatted text displayed in a monospace font.

questions.question_text: Which HTML element is used to embed an external webpage or document?
questions.option_a: <embed-page>
questions.option_b: <iframe>
questions.option_c: <web-view>
questions.option_d: <frame>
questions.explanation: An <iframe> is used to display a web page within a web page.

questions.question_text: Which HTML attribute specifies that an audio or video file should start over again every time it finishes?
questions.option_a: repeat
questions.option_b: loop
questions.option_c: replay
questions.option_d: infinite
questions.explanation: The loop attribute specifies that the audio/video will start over again automatically.

questions.question_text: What is the purpose of the <noscript> tag in HTML?
questions.option_a: Disables JavaScript on page
questions.option_b: Displays alternate content if JavaScript is disabled in the browser
questions.option_c: Blocks harmful viruses
questions.option_d: Logs script errors
questions.explanation: <noscript> provides fallback content when JavaScript is disabled or unsupported.

questions.question_text: Which tag defines a drop-down list in an HTML form?
questions.option_a: <dropdown>
questions.option_b: <list>
questions.option_c: <select>
questions.option_d: <input type="dropdown">
questions.explanation: <select> is used to create a drop-down list of <option> elements.

questions.question_text: Which element defines an option in a drop-down list?
questions.option_a: <item>
questions.option_b: <option>
questions.option_c: <list-item>
questions.option_d: <choice>
questions.explanation: <option> tags go inside <select> to define the selectable items.

questions.question_text: Which HTML tag is used for keyboard input display in documentation?
questions.option_a: <key>
questions.option_b: <kbd>
questions.option_c: <button>
questions.option_d: <input>
questions.explanation: <kbd> represents user input from a keyboard, voice input, or another text device.

questions.question_text: Which HTML5 element represents a disclosure widget from which the user can obtain additional information?
questions.option_a: <details>
questions.option_b: <summary>
questions.option_c: <accordion>
questions.option_d: <popup>
questions.explanation: <details> specifies additional details that the user can open and close on demand.

questions.question_text: Which tag is used as a summary/heading for a <details> element?
questions.option_a: <heading>
questions.option_b: <title>
questions.option_c: <summary>
questions.option_d: <caption>
questions.explanation: <summary> defines a visible heading for the <details> disclosure element.

questions.question_text: Which input type is specifically optimized for entering telephone numbers on mobile keyboards?
questions.option_a: <input type="number">
questions.option_b: <input type="tel">
questions.option_c: <input type="phone">
questions.option_d: <input type="digits">
questions.explanation: <input type="tel"> brings up telephone numeric keypads on mobile browsers.

questions.question_text: What is the default display value of a <div> element in CSS?
questions.option_a: inline
questions.option_b: inline-block
questions.option_c: block
questions.option_d: flex
questions.explanation: <div> is a block-level container element by default in standard browser stylesheets.

questions.question_text: What is the default display value of a <span> element in CSS?
questions.option_a: block
questions.option_b: inline
questions.option_c: none
questions.option_d: table
questions.explanation: <span> is an inline container element used for styling snippets of text.

questions.question_text: JavaScript Advanced Question 1: How does the JavaScript engine handle execution context, closures and event loop queues?
questions.option_a: Call stack executes synchronous code, while microtasks (Promises) run before macrotasks (setTimeout).
questions.option_b: JavaScript creates a new thread for every function call in modern V8.
questions.option_c: Closures immediately release outer variables to garbage collector on return.
questions.option_d: All variables declared with 'const' are deeply immutable and cannot mutate properties.
questions.explanation: In the JS event loop, the microtask queue has higher priority than macrotask queue.
